_comment: Checked-in license overrides for SwiftPM dependencies, used by generate-notices.py when a dependency's LICENSE file cannot be found under .build/checkouts (for example on a machine that has not built the package graph yet). Each entry gives the SPDX id, canonical license text URL, and copyright line to print. This does not replace fetching the real LICENSE file when it is available -- the script always prefers .build/checkouts when present.
